pages.text: Most metal decorations come from a $(item)stonecutter$(), one ingot at a time: $(li)$(item)Caution blocks$(): 1 aluminium ingot gives $(item)2$(), in any of fifteen colours. They are directional and face the way you place them. $(li)$(item)Factory floor$():

1 aluminium ingot gives $(item)1$() metal floor block. $(li)$(item)Bars$(): 1 ingot gives $(item)4$(), in steel, aluminium, cast iron, lead or nickel. $(li)$(item)Ladders$(): 1 ingot gives $(item)2$(), in steel, aluminium, cast iron, lead, nickel or constantan. $(li)$(item)Scaffolding$(): 1 ingot gives $(item)2$(), in steel or aluminium.

$(l)Doors$()$(br)All four TFMG doors are $(item)sliding doors$(), like Create's train doors:$(li)$(item)heavy plated door$(): 6 steel ingots give 3,$(li)$(item)aluminium door$(): 6 aluminium ingots give 3,$(li)$(item)steel door$(): a steel casing with any wooden door,$(li)$(item)heavy casing door$(): a heavy machinery casing with any wooden door.
The $(item)steel trapdoor$() takes a row of 3 steel ingots.$(br2)Steel and aluminium storage blocks, trusses and frames round out the set for structural looks.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
